Name: Bless
Description: You bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or save.
UpcastBonus: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level.

Name: Bane
Description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make a Save. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must substract 1d4 from the roll.
UpcastBonus: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level.

Name: Booming Blade
Description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5ft of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects and then becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5ft or more before then, the target takes 1d8 thunder damage and the spell ends.
UpcastBonus: Both the melee attack damage and the damage received from moving increase by 1d8 thunder damage when you reach levels 5,11, and 17
RequiredMaterialComp: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp
